mapper.insert: insert into message(conversation_id, sender_id, receiver_id, content, send_time, is_read, message_type) value (#{conversationId}, #{senderId}, #{receiverId}, #{content}, #{sendTime}, #{isRead}, #{messageType})
mapper.select:
select m.id, m.conversation_id, m.sender_id, m.receiver_id, m.content, m.send_time, m.is_read, m.message_type, s.username as sender_name, s.avatar as sender_avatar, r.username as receiver_name, r.avatar as receiver_avatar from message m left join user s on s.id = m.sender_id left join user r on r.id = m.receiver_id
m.content like concat('%', #{content}, '%')
order by m.send_time desc
